d: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Decision Tree Research Founder and CEO Gregory Allen says Jensen Huang should expect intense scrutiny from both Democrats and Republicans when the Nvidia CEO testifies on Capitol Hill next week. Former White House Acting Chief of Staff Mick Mulvaney says President Donald Trump appears out of touch with voters in his handling of the controversy surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.
